simple.meaning: כְּאֵב (kᵉʼêb) is a Hebrew word meaning “suffering (physical or mental), adversity.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כְּאֵב (H3511) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 2:13, with occurrences in Job, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כְּאֵב (H3511) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כְּאֵב (H3511) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כְּאֵב (kᵉʼêb) / H3511 is traced through Job 2:13, Job 16:6, Psalms 39:3, Isaiah 17:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

My heart was hot within me.
